scope: WARM-owned Chroma importer and DSPy adapters at dependency versions chromadb1.5.9,dspy3.4.1,diskcache5.6.3. Analysis plus source changes, no lane execution and no advisory dismissal.

candidate_files.change: RustClient with explicit str(path) preserving PersistentClient Path coercion; None embedding function; returned scope/name checks before reads; reject unsafe collection path components.
Existing poisoned-config3cases plus2backend-environment and11HTTP-transport cases; no tests executed by lane.
Real dspy.Embedder invoked with per-call caching=False; plain callable signature preserved.
Same per-call cache bypass; convert real Embedder ndarray to list for SDK HTTP serialization.
Fresh-process positive cache-reachability control followed by real Embedder/ordinary callable sync/async/SDK/error-path checks under cache/import/global-policy traps.

minimum_version.reason: This is the reviewed safe backend API/configuration boundary, not a claim that RustClient was first introduced in1.5.9. Existing >=0.5 declaration cannot support this security disposition across historical implementations.

root_owned_changes.change: Refresh requires-dist/group metadata; existing resolved chromadb version is already1.5.9.

minimum_version.preserved: Local directory and HTTP import, selected/default tenant/database, selected/all collections, count/paging/stored vectors/documents/metadata/URIs. No fallback to SegmentAPI; no global Chroma settings mutation.
minimum_version.compatibility_limit: Published >=floor permits future versions; re-evaluate these callgraphs on every dependency change. Existing persistent-store migration/roundtrip/resume tests remain required; this lane did not prove compatibility for every historical store format.

chroma_callgraphs.local_before: ChromaSource._connect -> PersistentClient -> Settings() -> ClientCreator -> SharedSystemClient.instance(ServerAPI). Settings.chroma_api_impl defaults RustBindingsAPI but reads CHROMA_API_IMPL. SegmentAPI is explicitly accepted by SharedSystemClient. Thus the earlier default-Rust assumption was insufficient.
chroma_callgraphs.dangerous_local_before: SegmentAPI.list_collections/get_collection -> SqlSysDB.get_collections -> load_collection_configuration_from_json_str at535 -> load_collection_configuration_from_json -> known_embedding_functions[name].build_from_config. This can instantiate a model before the importer receives a Collection; embedding_function=None at subsequent get_collection cannot prevent it.
chroma_callgraphs.local_after: Source._connect at82 -> chromadb.RustClient at231 -> Settings() then overwrite chroma_api_impl=chromadb.api.rust.RustBindingsAPI at249 before ClientCreator -> RustBindingsAPI. list_collections/get_collection at191/266 call native bindings and put configuration_json into plain transport models, without Python configuration loaders. _count/_get at390/416 forward collection UUID and established tenant/database to native bindings.
chroma_callgraphs.http: Source._connect -> chromadb.HttpClient at260 -> force chromadb.api.fastapi.FastAPI at297. This is the outbound HTTP client, not chromadb.server.fastapi.FastAPI. Initialization reads /auth/identity and tenant/database existence; list/get parse JSON using CollectionModel.from_json attypes.py186, retaining configuration_json and schema as dictionaries.
chroma_callgraphs.common_reader: Client.get_collection at239 validates EF-name conflict without constructing persisted EF, then CollectionCommon.__init__ stores model. Source selects embedding_function=None, checks returned collection scope/name, invokes count and Collection.get. _validate_and_prepare_get_request at258 validates IDs/filters/includes; _transform_get_response at510 returns stored arrays. Include excludes data, so URI data_loader is unused. Neither _embed nor configuration/schema properties are accessed.
chroma_callgraphs.scope_gap_before: CollectionCommon.tenant/database at172/176 return response-model fields; Collection.get/count use them for later request URLs. A mismatched response could redirect subsequent authenticated count/get calls to a different scope. Initial client tenant/database arguments alone did not enforce this boundary.
chroma_callgraphs.scope_after: Source validates both listed Collection objects and fetched Collection objects against client.tenant/client.database and expected name, rejecting before count/get. Untrusted returned path components are rejected before name lookup; explicit selected names are also checked. Caller-provided tenant/database are not replaced by this patch; existing Chroma identity-resolution semantics remain.
chroma_callgraphs.limits: Native Rust authorization implementation is not proven generally secure by excluding the named Python vulnerable functions. A malicious or vulnerable external server can still lie about data while returning matching scope metadata; client checks do not replace server-side authorization.

alerts.local: The hardened RustClient reader does not construct the Python HTTP server or call create_collection. Before backend hardening, related model construction was reachable through SegmentAPI reads; do not use earlier None-only change as a non-reachability argument.
alerts.http: Outbound requests only identity/tenant/database/list/get/count; there is no POST to the collections creation endpoint. Response config remains opaque in reviewed client path.
alerts.candidate_disposition: vulnerable_code_not_used within the hardened importer only, conditional on passing backend/HTTP/config regressions and updating the declared minimum.
alerts.external_server: An independently operated Python Chroma server remains vulnerable to its own exposed creation endpoint. WARM does not patch or certify that service.

alerts.vulnerable_entry: chromadb.server.fastapi.FastAPI.update_collection at925: after auth at937, load_update_collection_configuration_from_json at947 builds attacker-selected model configuration.
alerts.local: No server/update path is used; explicit Rust backend excludes the related eager Python configuration loader on reads.
alerts.http: Importer never sends PUT/PATCH collection updates or calls modify; get/count/read-only POST get does not dispatch this function.
alerts.candidate_disposition: vulnerable_code_not_used within hardened importer after required regressions, not package-fixed.
alerts.external_server: Users who run the installed chromadb distribution as a standalone Python server or call collection update APIs remain exposed outside this reviewed importer path.

alerts.vulnerable_entry: chromadb.auth.simple_rbac_authz.SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider.authorize_or_raise at58 checks action membership at63-64 and ignores resource tenant/database/collection.
alerts.local: RustBindingsAPI initialization and read methods do not instantiate/call Python ServerAuthorizationProvider. Local directory access is under filesystem trust; importer is not a multi-user Chroma authorization server.
alerts.http: ClientAuthProvider only supplies outgoing headers; it does not invoke ServerAuthorizationProvider. The remote server may invoke the vulnerable RBAC implementation on legitimate importer requests.
alerts.candidate_disposition: vulnerable_code_not_used for the installed WARM-side client/importer code; never extend the disposition to the remote Chroma server.
alerts.external_server: Remote resource-specific authorization still needs a real upstream/configuration remedy. Collection scope checks preserve requested scope but cannot verify the remote user's entitlement.

alerts.vulnerable_entry: SegmentAPI._get/_count -> _scan(collection_id) -> SqlSysDB.get_collection_with_segments at574 -> get_collections(id=...) at577. get_collections skips tenant/database filter when id is supplied at511. The1.5.9 route differs slightly from the report's older _get_collection path but retains the unscoped lookup.
alerts.local_before: Reachable when CHROMA_API_IMPL selected SegmentAPI. list/name resolution initially scopes IDs, but subsequent UUID scan uses the vulnerable function; do not label that implementation unused.
alerts.local_after: RustClient prevents this Python SegmentAPI/SqlSysDB read path. No UUID override is exposed by importer; collection UUID comes from a scope-validated collection.
alerts.http: The WARM-side library sends scoped URLs, not Python SysDB calls. A remote Python SegmentAPI service may execute the vulnerable lookup; returned-model scope is now checked before subsequent requests.
alerts.candidate_disposition: vulnerable_code_not_used only for the hardened installed WARM-side reader; remote server boundary explicitly excluded.
alerts.external_server: No assertion that a remote vulnerable server becomes safe. Its authorization bug cannot be fixed by selecting a tenant/database in a client.

alerts.vulnerable_entry: Disk.fetch at254 unpickles stored value bytes/files at282/284. Disk.get at165 unpickles serialized keys at177.
alerts.actual_owned_reachability_before: WarmRetriever._coerce_embedder accepts real dspy.Embedder. Dimension inference, ingestion and query call it with default caching=True. Embedder.__call__ at138 selects _cached_compute_embeddings -> request_cache.sync_wrapper at269 -> dspy.cache at272 -> lazy _get_dspy_cache with enable_disk_cache=True -> Cache.get at135 -> FanoutCache.get at257 -> shard Cache.get at1123 -> Disk.fetch. SDK WarmRM.forward calls the same supplied Embedder before its subsequent ndarray serialization failure, so deserialization occurs even if the query later fails.
alerts.known_key_path: The normal DSPy request key is a SHA256 hex string; ordinary Cache.get reads a value via Disk.fetch, not Disk.get. No WARM-owned key-iteration/pull/export call was found. Do not infer keys are globally safe: diskcache iteration/pull APIs and DSPy restricted Disk subclasses can retain Disk.get unpickling outside this path.
alerts.remedy: Both owned adapters invoke actual dspy.Embedder instances with caching=False for that call only; Embedder then selects _compute_embeddings and preserves model/batch/kwargs behavior. SDK converts resulting ndarray to list. Generic callables are invoked with the same positional signature; global cache settings and embedding.caching remain unchanged.
alerts.other_owned_paths: Default HashingEmbedder and ordinary WARM retrieval do not call diskcache. DSPy Module.__call__/acall at94/113 add callback/usage context and dispatch forward without cache access. The owned DummyLM RAG example already sets memory-only cache before first cache/LM use and has a fresh-process import-denial test. User-supplied arbitrary callable/protocol implementations, custom callbacks, and separate application LM/cache use are outside the no-deserialization claim.
alerts.candidate_disposition: Do not dismiss based on the earlier example alone. After the new real-Embedder regression and existing profile tests pass, vulnerable_code_not_used can be scoped to these reviewed WARM-owned paths; diskcache itself remains unpatched and caller-controlled persistent cache use remains excluded.

http_response_boundary_proof.fixture: Actual chromadb1.5.9 HttpClient, httpx.Client and JSON model parsing with httpx.MockTransport; no network listener or standalone Chroma server.
http_response_boundary_proof.cases: Valid named/all collections; tenant mismatch named/all; database mismatch named/all; wrong returned name on named lookup; returned ../other named/all; returned percent-encoded slash on list; explicitly requested ../other.
security_oracles: Every request retains the fixture credential and expected host; any unlisted route fails.
Stored config and schema include poison payloads; known EF constructor and configuration/schema/_embed accesses fail immediately.
Stored URI remains metadata, never a network data-loader input.
Valid page0/page1 reads preserve id, namespace, text, vector and metadata.
not_proven: Arbitrary malformed/oversized JSON, malicious metadata variants, historical Chroma versions or future versions.
No passed runtime result claimed by this lane.
